purpose: Specify the smallest owner-correct replacement for the seven historical org.systemmaster.core dependencies consumed by the recovered Book Java tree. This specification defines Book-required ports, exact Book-side request/response invariants, call-site migrations, failure behavior and qualification denominator without registering provider operations, implementing provider code, or mutating the recovered Book source graph.

design_decision.summary: Replace seven historical public org.systemmaster.core dependencies with two direct current CORE shared types, one Book-owned artifact-read port backed by a registered CORE operation, one Book-owned research-provider port backed by a registered RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE operation, and one CORE-owned shared data-classification contract/schema. No historical compatibility type is copied into Book solely to satisfy javac.

direct_reuse_bindings.binding_rule: Bind recovered Book descriptor registries directly to the current shared CORE CapabilityDescriptor type only when the exact current source/package remains compatible with the census-bound SHA evidence or fresh changed-subject qualification proves the replacement.
Bind recovered Book descriptor registries directly to current shared CORE EffectClass. Book may consume effect classification but may not redefine CORE effect semantics.

book_owned_ports.provider_domain_rule: CORE owner must bind this role to a current capability/platform domain allowed by SYSTEM-MASTER-SYSTEM-INTERFACE-BLUEPRINT-001; Book does not assign the provider domain or operation_id.
book_owned_ports.book_need: Replay exact already-admitted raw/text artifact bytes by content digest so Book can independently verify source evidence before Book admission.

response_shape.bytes: bounded byte payload or equivalent provider-approved byte stream
response_shape.provider_subject_ref: exact provider implementation/standing identity when qualification depends on it

book_acceptance_laws: Book recomputes SHA-256 over returned bytes and requires equality to expected_sha256.
Book rejects size mismatch, digest mismatch, unverified artifact standing, missing receipt identity, over-budget response or provider error.
A successful CORE read is evidence only and cannot mutate Book canonical state.
Book never receives or reads CORE private storage roots/tables directly.

book_owned_ports.book_need: Submit one exactly bound Book research request and receive provider-owned source/provenance projections while keeping Book-specific authorization, source verification, locator construction, evidence admission and canon decisions inside BOOK.

request_shape.principal_ref: caller/user principal reference when required by provider policy
request_shape.query_sha256: SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 query_text under the provider contract
request_shape.book_authorization_ref: exact BOOK ExternalSearchAuthorization or local-search admission evidence
request_shape.semantic_binding_snapshot_ref: exact current Book context/binding identity when applicable
request_shape.requested_at: timestamp metadata not used as semantic request identity

request_identity_laws: query_sha256 binds exact query_text; provider independently verifies the digest.
Book does not depend on a public SearchDigests compatibility class; SHA-256 algorithm and canonical UTF-8 bytes are contract data.
Mutable timestamps, retry counters, chat labels and provider attempt ids do not define semantic Book request identity.
External search is admitted only after Book proves every contributing fragment is eligible for external egress and the exact request matches Book work, purpose and query text.
Provider execution does not grant Book admission or canon authority.

source_projection_shape.title: source title
source_projection_shape.text_artifact_ref: optional CORE-backed admitted extracted-text artifact ref
source_projection_shape.extracted_text: optional bounded text projection; treated by Book as untrusted source data

book_acceptance_laws: Book requires exact source_id + snapshot_id + content_sha256 binding before admitting source evidence.
Book verifies raw/text artifact bytes through BOOK-PORT-CORE-VERIFIED-ARTIFACT-READ-V1 rather than trusting projection text or refs by assertion.
Book recomputes normalized text digest before creating locators/evidence anchors.
A stale snapshot, changed text, forged digest, missing artifact ref, provider provenance gap or currentness conflict fails closed.
Research evidence is untrusted source data and never executable instruction.
Research result/provenance semantics remain RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE-owned; Book owns only Book-specific selection, verification, locator/evidence binding and admission decisions.

minimum_book_required_semantics: PUBLIC classification identity sufficient for external research admission
ordered sensitivity/equivalence semantics only if the current CORE contract exposes them
stable schema/version identity so changed classification semantics invalidate stale Book bindings
shared_classification_contract.book_rule: Book may store provider-issued classification values as part of Book evidence/authorization records but must not silently redefine the shared classification taxonomy or copy the historical enum as current authority.

book_call_site_migration.target: Validate/store CORE-contract classification token/reference; external egress gate requires canonical PUBLIC identity.
Build/validate BOOK-PORT-RESEARCH-SOURCE-QUERY-V1 request from exact ResearchQuery and classification contract; issue Book-local ExternalSearchAuthorization before external execution.
Accept RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE source projection and replay raw/text artifacts through BOOK-PORT-CORE-VERIFIED-ARTIFACT-READ-V1 before creating VerifiedArchivedSource.
Operate on the admitted provider source projection or a Book-owned immutable verified-source snapshot derived from it; preserve exact snapshot/text/digest fail-closed checks.
Replace fixtures with Book port fakes and provider-contract projections; retain stale snapshot, altered text, forged digest, private-fragment egress and request-binding negative cases.

module_and_dependency_change.recovered_book_source: Do not add historical UAF Core classes to the Book source tree.
core_compile_dependencies: provider-registered artifact-read client/contract after CORE owner supplies it
provider-published classification schema/value contract after CORE owner supplies it
research_knowledge_compile_dependencies: provider-registered RESEARCH source-query request/response contract after RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE owner supplies it
module_and_dependency_change.book_owned_adapter_policy: Book may define narrow internal ports and adapters that consume registered provider contracts. Book may not implement the provider's semantic operation or private store.

cross_peer_dependency_blockers.required_result: A current, registered, qualified CORE public operation or shared client contract satisfying READ_VERIFIED_ARTIFACT_BY_DIGEST with exact receipt/digest/size semantics.
A current CORE-owned classification schema/value contract with stable version identity and canonical PUBLIC semantics usable by Book authorization.
A current, registered, qualified RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE public RESEARCH query/API operation returning source/provenance projections with exact request/receipt identity.

required_before_source_mutation: CORE owner supplies current artifact-read provider contract/operation satisfying the specified Book role.
CORE owner supplies current classification contract satisfying the specified Book role.
RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE owner supplies current registered source-query contract/operation satisfying the specified Book role.
Book rebind record pins exact provider operation/schema identities and changed-subject qualification requirements.
No live Book lane conflict/lease violation exists.
implementation_admission_gate.rule: Provider registration is an owner-lane action. This Book interface specification cannot make an unregistered operation callable by naming it.

direct_compile: direct Manuscript source compile on the migrated exact candidate
whole recovered Book main/test source compile on the migrated exact candidate
focused_behavior: all 21 recovered Book portable test mains or their explicitly mapped non-vacuous successors
external research rejects any non-PUBLIC contributing Book fragment
provider error identity is retained when mapped by Book
research/provider success cannot mutate Book canonical state
no historical five compatibility types remain as Book public compile dependencies
cumulative: fresh exact-subject evidence for changed provider bindings
future_candidate_qualification_denominat.non_vacuity: Zero discovered tests, skipped-only execution, compile-only green, historical PASS reuse, or provider registration without a real Book binding is failure.

successor_rule.next_book_action_after_provider_contract: Create BIDAG-004-DEP-02 exact provider rebind record, implement the smallest Book call-site/dependency migration, then run direct Manuscript + whole recovered Book compile and the specified qualification denominator.

forbidden_actions: Copy ArtifactGateway, DataClassification, SearchRequest, SearchDigests or SourceArchiveDocument from UAF into Book/current main merely to restore compilation.
Create Book-owned public operations that impersonate CORE or RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE providers.
Invent a provider operation_id and treat it as registered.
Read CORE or RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE private databases/storage directly.
Let research/source/provider success self-admit or canonize Book state.
Treat CORE P03 Book durability operations as implicit authorization for unrelated artifact-read or classification APIs.
Claim the 21/21 historical compatibility replay qualifies a changed current migration.
Close BIDAG-004-DEP-02 before current direct and whole-tree compile plus non-vacuous behavioral evidence pass.
Advance to BOOK-COMP-13 while BIDAG-004-DEP-02 remains open.
